agent_service_url.title: Agent Service URL
agent_service_url.description: Internal HTTP URL of the agent-service batch ingestion endpoint.

datasource_id.title: Datasource ID
datasource_id.description: UUID of the datasource collection in langchain_pg_collection.

connector_type.title: Connector Type
connector_type.description: Optional source connector type (for metadata), e.g. mongodb.

agent_token.title: Agent Service Bearer Token
agent_token.description: Optional bearer token sent to agent-service ingestion endpoints.

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Number of records to buffer before sending a batch. Lower = less RAM, higher = fewer HTTP calls.

request_timeout_seconds.title: Request Timeout (seconds)
request_timeout_seconds.description: HTTP timeout for each batch POST to agent-service.
